mintAuthority.summary: Wintermute USDC Select mints USDC-backed deposit shares and may mint fee shares during accrual. Circle USDC issuance is inherited; owner and curator retain strategy parameter powers. The six-market borrower basket also includes nested Morpho V1 USDC vault shares (v-wmtUSDC), separately from PT-reUSD and PT-USDat collateral.
